description: Share an entire Folder (and its Lists/tasks) with a guest at a chosen permission level. Returns the updated guest. Enterprise plan only.

folder_id.description: ID of the Folder to share.

guest_id.description: ID of the guest (the guest user's numeric id).

permission_level.description: Permission level to grant: 'read' (view only), 'comment', 'edit', or 'create'.

name: add_guest_to_folder
